title: Lubiechów Palm House entrance garden
note: The maintained garden at the Palm House entrance uses three mapped lawns around the native loop path. Operator photos guide the urn, clipped topiary and timber benches. The exact plant species, ornaments and dates of changes are interpreted. Former nursery plots and the wider castle park are outside this placement.
